title: Too Much Sugar
text: I looked at the contents of Auschnitt's Jerky and other than the flavors like the Teriyaka which contains sugar, Even the Regular Jerky has Brown Sugar in it, or ingredients with sugar.  This is another Company that promotes "Quality" when it is still Garbage. The only Ingredients that should be in Regular Jerky should be Soy Sauce or Salt.  And the Peppered Jerky should only have Soy Sauce or Salt and Pepper.  All the other Garbage is NOT needed.  I deem this Product Unhealthy.
label: negative
